beats.text: Under [2.5 days] of brand work a week? Don't hire full-time.
£90,000 a year all-in against £700 a day.
Break-even sits at about 129 days a year.
Below that, a salary buys [idle capacity].
Above it, the full-time hire costs less per day.
Never measured it? Run a fractional quarter and count.

end.title: Count the days before you buy headcount.
